reader.requirement: A CALL USING parameter passed BY REFERENCE (explicit or implied) makes the called program's corresponding Linkage item, under whatever name, occupy the caller's storage, for every operand X.5.2.3 SR3 allows (01/77 or elementary items of File, Working-Storage or Linkage, subscripted elements, variable-occurrence groups), transitively through further calls and when one item is passed twice; BY CONTENT does not establish a common item.

edition-consulted.switches: construct call-function-identifier-argument-2002: a function-identifier argument is refused at 85 (X.5.2.3 SR4); Format2OnlySpellingOf refuses BY VALUE and OMITTED at 85
construct program-prototype-name-2002: how a bare word in identifier-1 resolves; not the parameter mechanism

reader.edition-search: grep Edition|CobolVersion|Dialect|Constructs over CallBinder.cs and CallEmitter.cs; the by-reference carrier (ArgCarrierText) is edition-free, the edition reads are argument-form refusals
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: by-reference sharing is the same; 85 refuses the later argument forms (BY VALUE, OMITTED, function-identifier)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf32_01 passes three Working-Storage 01 items; not a subordinate elementary item, a subscripted element, a File Section record, a variable-occurrence group, the same item twice, BY CONTENT beside BY REFERENCE, or a Linkage item passed on to a further call

reader.notes: The by-reference carrier passes the caller's storage, so every probed operand class was shared, including aliasing of one item passed twice and a parameter forwarded from Linkage. The edition reads on the path only refuse argument forms 1985 lacks.

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:X.1.3.6 GR3, X.5.2.3 SR3/SR4 and X.5.2.4 GR10-GR14. p3.cob at --std 85 (runs/p3-002; runs/p3-001 ended EC-PROGRAM-NOT-FOUND because P3F was a non-COMMON sibling, correct per X.1.3.8.1 SR1, fixed by COMMON): (f) CALL USING K T(K) with the callee moving 3 to L-K before storing L-E -> 'MAIN T 711 K 3' (the element bound at CALL time, not re-subscripted); (d) PIC X(4) passed to a PIC 9(4) Linkage item with a group REDEFINES -> 'A SEES AB/CD', caller then 'X4 1234' (one storage, different description); a GLOBAL item passed by reference to a contained program -> 'B GLOBAL NOW NEW' after a store through the parameter and 'B PARAM NOW MID' after a store through the global name, 'MAIN GL MID' (no copy-in/copy-out during the call); BY CONTENT CC and 77-level W77 then BY REFERENCE X4, the callee forwarding L-X BY CONTENT to COMMON P3F that stores into it -> 'MAIN CC CC W77 -005 X4 1234' (GR12 transitivity, GR14); a reference-modified operand RM(3:2) -> 'E SEES cd', 'MAIN RM abZZef' (shared at the offset). cite.py: 'OK  §1985:X.1.3.6 GR3 ... the text is in GR3'; 'OK  §1985:X.5.2.4 GR13 ... the text is in GR13'; 'OK  §1985:X.5.2.4 GR14 ... the text is in GR14'; 'OK  §1985:X.1.3.8.1 ... it lies in SR1'.
